summary: Comprehensive frontend regression testing of MedMatch-AI KARAU app. Tested Portal Selector, MedMatch Login, AI KARAU Meeting Portal (login, dashboard, create meeting, share meeting dialog), Guest Join Page, Meeting Room, i18n (French translation, Arabic RTL), and multiple app pages. All 20 tests passed successfully.

minor.issue: 401 responses on unauthenticated pages - expected behavior

issues: Welcome tour modal (Step 1/6) appears on every page visit - may interfere with navigation. Consider dismissing after first view.

portal_selector: Portal Selector page loads at root / with two portal options
MedMatch AI Job Toolkit card visible and clickable
AI KARAU Meeting Portal card visible and clickable
Language selector present in top-right corner
medmatch_portal: MedMatch Login page at /login renders correctly with email/password fields
MedMatch Login works with admin@medmatch.com / Swampdrainer2026!
After login, navigates to main dashboard
Interview Prep page loads at /interview with interview prep tools
Help & Tutorials page loads with video tutorials
Membership page loads with membership options
Admin Dashboard loads with admin features
karau_meeting_portal: AI KARAU Meeting Portal login at /karau-meet renders correctly
KARAU login works with admin@medmatch.com / Swampdrainer2026! (btn-signin testid)
Dashboard loads after login with meeting stats (24 meetings, 48 hours, 12 recordings, 156 participants)
Dashboard shows Recent Meetings list with Share buttons
Share button (Share2 icon) next to each meeting works
New Meeting button opens create meeting dialog
Create meeting dialog has 'Create & Share' and 'Start Meeting' buttons
Create & Share creates meeting and opens share dialog
guest_join_page: Guest Join Page at /karau-meet/join/{meetingId} renders with correct testids
Guest can enter name and join meeting - navigates to /karau-meet/room/{meetingId}
Guest Join Page shows 'Meeting Not Found' for invalid meeting IDs (e.g., /karau-meet/join/INVALID123)
Back to Portal button present on error page (data-testid='guest-back-btn')
meeting_room: Meeting Room renders with video controls (Mute, Stop, Share, Raise, Leave)
Meeting Room has Chat, AI Notes, Background panels
Meeting Room header has Share button (data-testid='meeting-share-btn')
i18n_testing: Language selector changes language across app
French translation works - 'Bienvenue sur' displayed on Portal Selector
Arabic language enables RTL layout - document.dir='rtl'

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are correctly implemented for automated testing
Share Meeting feature fully functional with link copy, ICS download, and Google Calendar integration
Guest join flow properly stores user data in localStorage and navigates to meeting room
i18n implementation working correctly with 32 language support and RTL for Arabic
Welcome tour modal appears on every page - consider adding a dismiss state in localStorage
